tooltip.frontierhunts.beta.title: Beta - work in progress
tooltip.frontierhunts.beta.egg: This animal is still being built. It doesn't spawn in the wild yet; spawn it here to try it out.
tooltip.frontierhunts.beta.tag: Covers beta animals that don't spawn in the wild yet.
hunts.frontierhunts.card.beta: Beta - work in progress. This animal doesn't spawn in the wild yet and its contracts are not posted. Creative players can try it from its spawn egg.
journal.frontierhunts.check.species_8.hi: Any three species from the species log, by your own shot.
Take one of every game species in the wild: whitetail, elk, moose, ruffed grouse and mallard.
journal.frontierhunts.check.eat_game.hin: Eat wild game: venison, backstrap, elk or moose meat, wild fowl, jerky or pemmican.
journal.frontierhunts.check.predator_kil: Come upon the bones of an animal that died in the backcountry - winter, a fall, or old age.
journal.frontierhunts.check.wear_furs.hi: Wear a hide or fur garment (buckskin, fur hat, mukluks, a hide robe) or anything with a fur lining sewn in.
licence.frontierhunts.page.lic.what: Needed for all hunting on the reserve. Free after the Ranger Academy's Archery course.
licence.frontierhunts.page.seasons.varmi: Beta animals (coyotes, gray wolves, wild boar): not in the wild yet; no licence or tag needed when you try them.
frontierhunts.lw.book.lastentries.2:
Oct. 6
Bull bugling below camp at 2 am. Nobody slept. Moved the meat pole farther out.
frontierhunts.lw.book.rangerlog.4:
NOTES
Moose seen near the north creek. Elk moving down from the high basin. Duck flights heavy at the marsh at dawn.
frontierhunts.lw.note.ranger.0.1: Patrol: north creek, moose sign fresh.
